name: When should I consider fall prevention modifications for my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider fall prevention modifications for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider fall prevention modifications if you or a loved one are experiencing balance issues, have a history of falls, or are preparing for age-related changes that might impact mobility. Proactive modifications can significantly reduce future risks. Even without current issues, assessing your home for potential hazards, especially in high-risk areas like bathrooms and stairways, can be a wise preventative measure as you age or if you plan to care for an elderly family member.
